summary: The official Mutrah parcel layer is publicly queryable by native 3857 bboxes and matched ordinary 4326 counts. The source has 18,752 features, but PLOTUID alone is not unique. For the 12,212 rows with both PLOTUID and NEWPLOTNO non-null, there are 12,185 compound keys after accounting for 27 extra rows across 22 repeated pairs; all 22 repeated pairs are geometrically disjoint in 38 Turf comparisons and can be combined as multipart components. New phase, new housing-area, area code and block attributes agree within these pairs, though legacy PLOTNO/edit/area fields sometimes differ. A 6,534-row null NEWPLOTNO subset and six null PLOTUID rows remain unresolved; only the identified subset is a viable candidate.

limitations: This is a Mutrah Directorate source, not national Oman coverage.
PLOTUID alone is not unique: 18,746 non-null rows yield 18,482 distinct PLOTUID values, six PLOTUIDs are null, and 264 row occurrences repeat an existing PLOTUID.
PLOTUID+NEWPLOTNO is complete only for 12,212 rows where both are non-null; 6,534 NEWPLOTNO-null rows and six PLOTUID-null rows remain unkeyed by this pair.
All 22 repeated non-null compound pairs were disjoint in 38 Turf comparisons; geometry union is supported for this snapshot, with no overlapping same-key variants found.
Within repeated pairs, NEWPHASE and new housing/area/block values match, but legacy PLOTNO and edit metadata sometimes differ. This probe does not establish lifecycle status or temporal currency.
Source PLOTAREA was zero in the three sampled examples; areas in this report are calculated from geometry. No raw geometry or owner data were retained.
nextStep: Use only the PLOTUID+NEWPLOTNO non-null subset with a strict disjoint-parts union check; keep null-key rows unresolved. The root session independently passed the Mutrah regional geographic gate; do not extend this finding to national Oman coverage.
